pr_body:
Fixes a race condition wherein the `JsonSerializerOptions.CacheContext` property could be returning multiple instances, which can occasionally make this assertion fail:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/0ad3723332c37f6423a725fbd4ad889b8e0f3d7c/src/libraries/System.Text.Json/src/System/Text/Json/Serialization/Metadata/JsonTypeInfo.cs#L672

Fix #88102.
